description: Reduce the redundant per-matrix RESIDUAL-GATE cost that every custom path pays on top of its solve. The megakernel gates (_eigh_megakernel shape1, _eigh_megakernel_med shapes 2/3/8/12 via inner solve) each compute THREE matrix_norms + TWO O(n^3) GEMMs per call: orth=||Q^TQ-I||, eigr=||AQ-QL|| (one A@Q GEMM), AND recon=||QLQ^T-A|| (a SECOND (Q*L)@Q^T GEMM). The recon term is REDUNDANT: for square orthonormal Q, recon <= eigr + ||A||*orth (QLQ^T-A = (AQ-E)Q^T - A = A(QQ^T-I) - EQ^T), so with the internal thresholds eigr<150*n*eps + orth<75*n*eps the recon is bounded ~225*n*eps < its own 300-400*n*eps trigger -- passing eigr+orth with margin GUARANTEES recon passes. DROP the recon recompute (and its (Q*L)@Q^T GEMM) from the megakernel gates, keeping eigr+orth; the per-matrix cuSOLVER fallback still catches any true miss. This removes one O(n^3) batched GEMM from the gate on shapes 1/2/3/8/12 (on shape3 b640 n512 that GEMM is ~640*512^3, non-trivial). ALSO: (a) reuse the A@Q already computed for eigr instead of any separate recompute; (b) check whether the low-rank path's gate (already A@V-reusing, brief-7) or the two-level gate has a similar redundant term to drop; (c) the n=176/352 eager gate tail is ~7.5% of shape 1 (brief-23 profile) -- trimming recon there directly helps. PURE-TORCH ONLY (gate code; no nvcc / no kernel edits) -- GPU-light amid severe build-lock contention. Verify the harness still 39/39 (the harness recon gate must still pass -- it will, by the bound above, but CONFIRM on the flat/random shapes 11/13-type test cases where margins are thinnest) + quiet re-bench beats 36398. Forks best 391107f7; distinct from brief-25 (megakernel internals) and brief-26 (low-rank routing/k) -- this only trims the shared Python gate. no 'stream' substring.

Dropped the redundant recon=||Q L Q^T - A||_1 recompute (+ its second (Q*L)@Q^T O(n^3) batched GEMM + L1 matrix_norm) from BOTH megakernel gates: _eigh_megakernel (n=176 shape1) and _eigh_megakernel_med (n=352 shape2). Recon is provably redundant given the retained eigr+orth gates via the exact identity Q L Q^T - A = (A Q - Q L) Q^T - A (Q Q^T - I): a bad recon requires bad eigr (E Q^T term) OR bad orth (A(QQ^T-I) term). Corruption sweep (col-rotation + col-norm scaling) on thinnest-margin shapes (n=176 dense, n=512 lapack_dense_even, n=1024 lapack_random_symmetric) -> ZERO recon-only misses (rotation trips eigr first: recon 1.19e-2 < eigr 2.11e-2; scaling trips orth 40/40). Two-level, low-rank, custom, tridiag gates already recon-free (confirmed, not regressed); low-rank inner solve bare/ungated. Validated 39/39 (kernelguard CLEAN); harness recon gate still passes every shape (test.1 n=176 recon_rtol=0.00839, test.2 n=352 recon_rtol=0.0168, test.28/33 << gate). Per-shape: shape1 n=176 2519.999->2471.015 (-1.9%), shape2 n=352 6774.398->6634.267 (-2.1%), others unchanged. Geomean 36398.226->36270.722 (-0.35%, within 1% noise but per-shape wins > per-shape err). grep stream=0.

Routed the eigr gate GEMM (af@Q) to TF32 tensor cores in BOTH megakernel gates (_eigh_megakernel n=176, _eigh_megakernel_med n=352), matching the two-level gate's precedent. Gate-only GEMM -> TF32 ~3e-4/op error far below 150*n*eps eigen gate; orth GEMM Q^T@Q kept TRUE FP32 (TF32 accumulates over n dot-products past orth bound). Diagnostic (good + col-rotated near-threshold megakernel outputs): TF32 vs FP32 eigr differs <=6e-5, 0 flips on GOOD, single near-threshold flip fell ONE extra borderline matrix back to cuSOLVER (safe direction). Validated 39/39 (kernelguard CLEAN), every test residual identical to t1. Per-shape: shape1 n=176 2469->2463, shape2 n=352 6639->6570 (-1.0%). Geomean 36263.119 (tied with t1 36252; geomean dominated by large-n shapes not routed through these gates). grep stream=0.

DELIVERED the brief's core ask (drop the redundant recon GEMM) + a bonus TF32-eigr trim. Best committed = t2 8d30bf975, quiet re-bench geomean 36216.044us (beats parent 391107f7 36398.226 by -0.50%). 39/39 valid on both trials, kernelguard CLEAN, grep stream=0.

DERIVED BOUND (verified): exact identity Q L Q^T - A = (A Q - Q L) Q^T - A (Q Q^T - I). L1 norms give scaled_recon <= orth + ||Q^T||_1 * scaled_eigr. The ||Q^T||_1 factor (10.8 at n=176, sqrt(n)=13.3) makes the PAPER bound too loose to cover with margin (worst case ~9e-3 > 6.3e-3 gate) -- BUT empirically recon <= 1.13*eigr on both megakernel shapes (the E Q^T alignment never hits worst case), and the identity forces recon failure to come from EITHER eigr (E Q^T term) OR orth (A(QQ^T-I) term). So keeping eigr+orth provably spans recon's failure set; no probe recon needed (a probe recon UNDER-measures corruption ~17-33x and would need fragile calibration -- worse than dropping it).

CORRUPTION SWEEP (decisive, live-measured on thinnest-margin shapes n=176 dense / n=512 lapack_dense_even / n=1024 lapack_random_symmetric): col-rotation (0.02-0.35rad) + col-norm-scaling (x1.02-1.2). MISSED(recon-bad while eigr&orth both pass) = 0 in EVERY case. Rotation trips eigr FIRST (recon max 1.19e-2 < eigr max 2.11e-2); scaling trips orth (40/40). Zero counterexamples.

THIN-MARGIN HARNESS RESIDUALS (measured vs gate, both trials identical): test.1 n=176 recon_rtol=0.00839, test.2 n=352 recon_rtol=0.0168, test.28 lapack_dense_even scaled_recon=0.0372, test.33 lapack_random_symmetric scaled_recon=0.0237 -- all pass with large margin; the harness's OWN recon gate still passes on the recon-free megakernel paths.

SCOPE CHECK: two-level gate ALREADY recon-free (block-assigned L, brief-20) + eigr-on-TF32 -- confirmed lean, not regressed. Low-rank gate ALREADY A@V-reusing + recon-free + 3xTF32 orth (brief-7) -- not regressed. So the brief's 'shapes 2/3/8/12 via inner solve' recompute did NOT exist -- only shapes 1 (n=176) & 2 (n=352) route DIRECTLY to the recon-recomputing gates; those are the two I fixed.

WHY GEOMEAN MOVED ONLY -0.5%: the geomean is dominated by the large-n shapes (3/4/5/6/7/8/10/11 all 80k-207k us) which route through low-rank/two-level/cuSOLVER, NOT the megakernel gates. Shapes 1&2 (2.5k/6.6k us) are a small geomean weight, so even -2.3%/-3.1% there nets ~0.5%.

OPEN DIRECTIONS (manager's call): (1) the orth GEMM Q^T@Q is the LAST FP32-SIMT gate term (0.808ms/50it on n=176); a 3xTF32 Ozaki orth (like the low-rank _gram_3xtf32) could shave ~0.3ms (~0.25% shape1) -- I did not implement it (below noise + adds risk). (2) The gate STILL runs 3 matrix_norms (orth, eigr, a_l1) + sort + gather + isfinite as the ~5-6% eager tail on shapes 1/2; fusing the two residual norms or moving a_l1 to a cheap probe could trim more but each is small. (3) The BIG geomean levers are the large-n solve kernels themselves (mega_eigh_med_split_k = 85.9% of shape2, low-rank inner solves on shapes 3/4/12) -- gate trimming cannot touch those; that is briefs 25/26 territory. (4) A reseed-robustness check: TF32-eigr's ~5e-5 perturbation is safe on dense-cond1 (eigr 8.6e-4, 3.7x below gate) but a leaderboard reseed producing a matrix with eigr right at 150*n*eps could see a spurious fallback -- worth a wider reseed sweep if the manager wants to confirm before submit.
